notes_for_editor: The brief's record (built 1934, destroyed 1961, 20-foot L-4, Priest Lake TPA/IDL, gone) matches the four sources, so no corrections are proposed. The brief's coordinates match the register's position (N 48 39.443, W 116 50.032). Two searches and four page reads found no staffing history and no description of the site today. A 2016 Spokesman-Review item about a burned Priest Lake-area lookout concerns Little Snowy Top in Boundary County, not Bear Creek, so it is not used. Idaho Fire Lookouts' hike-in label is the only access evidence, so no access level is recorded. Photo credits on Idaho Fire Lookouts and firelookout.com (Fire Lookout Museum) come without image URLs, so none added.
